clauses.heading: Duplicate charges
clauses.text: A verified duplicate invoice charge may be reversed or credited after the invoice and payment references are confirmed. Multiple payment attempts are not evidence of multiple settled charges.

clauses.heading: Refund eligibility
clauses.text: An unused service order may be refunded when delivery has not started and no non-refundable commitment is recorded. A consequential refund proposal requires human review before execution.

clauses.heading: Identity verification
clauses.text: Account recovery requires a verified ownership check and account context refreshed within the last 24 hours before a recovery channel or multi-factor setting is changed.

clauses.heading: Unsafe recovery
clauses.text: Recovery must stop when ownership evidence is missing, pending, or conflicts with the current account record.

clauses.heading: Service failure
clauses.text: A service exception may be resolved only after the order or delivery record confirms the failed outcome and customer impact.

clauses.heading: Minimum necessary data
clauses.text: Case evidence and audit records must contain only the customer data required to explain and authorize the support decision.
